content.text: Monthly invoice PDFs generated from Billing → Invoices open correctly on page one (header, line items, totals) but always include a second page that is completely blank except for the footer page number.
A single-page invoice should produce a single-page PDF. Accounting users who archive invoices into their ERPs end up with empty pages that their OCR tools flag as corrupt or incomplete.

Hypothesis: the PDF renderer always appends a page-break after the totals block because the template still contains a residual page-break-after: always on .invoice-totals from when multi-page tax schedules were required. Removing that rule or gating it on content height over 720pt should drop the empty page.
